title: When, Where, How: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) adapt to a new task only through the labeled rows in their context. However, labels are expensive to acquire in real-world scenarios due to the need for highly specific domain knowledge to ensure high-quality data. Active in-context learning transfers classical acquisition rules to this setting, in which the model that guides acquisition changes with every label added. We ask how the value of diversity, predictive uncertainty and target-aware information gain changes as a frozen TFM acquires more context. For that, we study Target-Aware Nearest Neighbor (TANN) acquisition and the Expected Predictive Information Gain in Context (EPIC) and evaluate them against classical rules. Our study across twenty benchmarks with two well-established TFMs and classical GBDTs highlights three findings: (i) When: diversity-based acquisition is best during the first acquisition iterations; (ii) Where: labeling pool rows

translated_title: 何时、何地、如何：面向表格基础模型的主动上下文学习
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）仅通过其上下文中的带标注行来适应新任务。然而，在现实场景中，标签的获取成本高昂，因为需要高度专业的领域知识来确保数据质量。主动上下文学习将经典的采集规则迁移到这一设定中，其中引导采集的模型会随着每个标签的添加而发生变化。我们探究了随着冻结的TFM获取更多上下文，多样性、预测不确定性和目标感知信息增益的价值如何变化。为此，我们研究了目标感知最近邻（TANN）采集方法和上下文中的期望预测信息增益（EPIC），并将它们与经典规则进行评估比较。我们在二十个基准数据集上，使用两个成熟的TFM和经典GBDT开展研究，得出了三个发现：(i) 何时：基于多样性的采集在最初的采集迭代中效果最佳；(ii) 何地：标注池中的行……
tldr: 本文针对表格基础模型提出主动上下文学习方法，研究了目标感知最近邻（TANN）采集和上下文期望预测信息增益（EPIC）两种策略，并在二十个基准上发现基于多样性的采集在初期迭代中最为有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes active in-context learning for tabular foundation models, studying Target-Aware Nearest Neighbor (TANN) acquisition and Expected Predictive Information Gain in Context (EPIC), and finds across twenty benchmarks that diversity-based acquisition works best during the early acquisition iterations.
